board: RDM6300 125KHz EM4100 RFID reader module (38.5 x 19 mm, P1 TX/RX/-/GND/+5V, P2 ANT1/ANT2, P3 LED/+5V/GND, with coil antenna)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico: the sim streams the datasheet's 14-byte frame (0x02, 10 ASCII hex ID, ASCII hex XOR checksum, 0x03) only while a tag is present, and the driver verifies the checksum and decodes the tag and card number. TX is 5 V TTL, so the build notes say to use a divider into 3.3 V GPIOs.
breakoutPinoutSource: RDM630/RDM6300 spec pin definition (P1 TX,RX,-,GND,+5V; P2 ANT1,ANT2; P3 LED,+5V,GND) and https://microcontrollerslab.com/rdm6300-rdm630-rfid-reader-esp32-tutorial/
